title: Conversation Rather Than Location Is the Secret to a Successful First Date
titleZh: 第一次约会，聊得好比坐得舒服更重要
summary:
筹备第一次约会最让人头疼的，莫过于挑选一个绝佳的去处。是走传统路线，去吃顿晚餐再看场电影？还是尝试更大胆的选择，找一个新奇又刺激的场所？但万一选错了场合，还没开始就把机会毁了，该怎么办？根据最新发表在《Collabra》期刊上的一项研究，其实不必过于纠结。研究指出，在第一次约会中，见面场所其实并不重要——真正决定成败的，是你们之间的对话。

来源：Discover（发现）；作者：Stephanie Edwards；原文发布时间：2025-09-17 20:00:00

paragraphs.contentEn: One of the most stressful parts of planning a first date is trying to pick the perfect place. Do you stay traditional and take them to dinner and a movie? Be more adventurous and choose somewhere unexpected and exciting? What if you choose the wrong place and ruin your shot before you even have a chance? According to a new study, published in Collabra, you can rest easily. When it comes to a first date, location doesn’t really matter at all – it’s all about the conversation.
paragraphs.contentZh: 筹备第一次约会最让人头疼的，莫过于挑选一个绝佳的去处。是走传统路线，去吃顿晚餐再看场电影？还是尝试更大胆的选择，找一个新奇又刺激的场所？但万一选错了场合，还没开始就把机会毁了，该怎么办？根据最新发表在《Collabra》期刊上的一项研究，其实不必过于纠结。研究指出，在第一次约会中，见面场所其实并不重要——真正决定成败的，是你们之间的对话。

paragraphs.contentEn: “It’s not necessarily the environment where the interaction is taking place that makes the biggest difference, but rather the quality of the interaction and conversation,” said Daisi Brand, corresponding author of the study from the University of Georgia, in a press release. “It might not be how comfortable the space and physical surroundings are, but really how comfortable you make the other person feel.”
paragraphs.contentZh: 该研究的通讯作者、佐治亚大学的黛西·布兰德在一份新闻稿中表示：“决定性因素不一定是互动发生的场所，而是互动与交流的质量。真正重要的，或许并不在于空间和周围环境有多舒适，而在于你能否让对方感到放松自在。”

paragraphs.contentEn: To find out whether location really matters when getting to know someone for the first time, researchers randomly matched 200 participants into pairs. These pairs were then split into two groups: one group that went on a first date in a nice location and the other that spent their first date in a lackluster location. The nice location included comfy furniture and mood-appropriate lighting, while the plain location had hard, wooden chairs and was full of junk.
paragraphs.contentZh: 为了探究在初次建立了解关系时，约会地点是否真的重要，研究人员招募了200名参与者，并将他们随机两两配对。随后，这些配对者被分成两组：一组在布置雅致的场所进行首次约会，另一组则被安排在环境简陋的场合。前者的场所配有舒适的家具和契合氛围的灯光，后者则只有硬质的木椅，且四周堆满杂物。

paragraphs.contentEn: Once placed in these locations, participants used the Fast-Friends Paradigm, a set of 36 questions aimed at enhancing one’s ability to get to know someone. Researchers found that the pairs successfully and deeply connected with one another, regardless of their location. Even after a month had passed, participants from both first date locations reported still having fond feelings for their date partner and for the experience as a whole.
paragraphs.contentZh: 进入各自的约会场所后，参与者采用了一套名为“快速建立友谊范式”的方法——通过相互提问36个预设问题来增进彼此了解。研究人员发现，无论约会环境如何，这些配对的参与者都能顺利并深入地建立联系。即便在一个月后的回访中，两组不同约会地点的参与者依然表示，他们对约会对象和这段经历保持着积极的感受。

paragraphs.contentEn: “I think the reason that we didn’t find differences between these settings is because of the meaningful conversations that were happening in both spaces. Participants reported knowing that they weren’t in an appealing setting, but they still felt close or romantically attracted to the other person,” said Brand in the press release. The only difference recorded between the two locations was that pairs in the nicer location had the urge to get to know their partner better afterwards, both emotionally and physically.
paragraphs.contentZh: 布兰德在新闻稿中指出：“我认为，之所以没有在不同环境之间发现差异，原因在于两个空间中都发生了有意义的交流。参与者虽然意识到环境本身并不吸引人，但依然感到与对方很亲近，甚至产生了浪漫的好感。”研究记录显示，两种环境之间唯一的区别是：在布置雅致的场所中，参与者在约会结束后更想要从情感和身体上进一步了解对方。

paragraphs.contentEn: The study shows that stressing out about the location of a first date should be low on your priority list. Instead, focus on these things to ensure the best chance of a lasting connection: Openness and vulnerability will help make your date partner feel more comfortable than any fancy location; Ask meaningful questions to learn more about your date and allow them to open up themselves; When asked questions yourself, focus on providing sincere answers that give people a glimpse into who you really are and what you value.
paragraphs.contentZh: 这项研究指出，第一次约会时，挑选见面场所不必成为你最优先考虑的事情。真正值得关注的是以下几点，这些因素更有助于建立持久的联系：保持开放与真诚的自我表露，比任何精致的场所都更能让对方感到放松；提出有深度的问题，以此更好地了解对方，并鼓励他们向你敞开心扉；当你被问及问题时，给出真诚的回答，让对方能够看见真实的你，以及你所看重的东西。

paragraphs.contentEn: “Try to focus less on orchestrating the ‘perfect’ scenario and more on genuinely connecting with the person in front of you,” said Richard Slatcher, professor and adviser on the study, in the press release. “When two people really start engaging with each other, it seems that the surroundings take a back seat. You could have rose petals and candlelight or fluorescent lights and plain walls – it doesn’t matter that much if you’re both clicking.” In the future, the research team hopes to continue learning what makes the perfect first date, and whether factors like room temperature and the type of food being served influences relationship success.
paragraphs.contentZh: 该研究的顾问理查德·斯莱彻教授在新闻稿中表示：“与其耗费心力营造所谓‘完美’的场景，不如专注于与眼前的人建立真诚的联结。当两个人真正投入交流时，周围的环境自然变得不再重要。无论是铺满玫瑰花瓣、点着烛光，还是只有日光灯和白墙——只要双方真正投缘，这些都没那么重要。” 未来，研究团队希望继续探究什么才算是完美的第一次约会，以及室温、食物类型等因素是否会影响一段关系的走向。
